# PaginationSize

`Flare.Components.PaginationSize`

Size of FlarePagination controls. Medium is the default and matches the Xs..Xl scale used across Flare components (e.g. FlareButton, form fields).

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Xs` | `0` | Extra small. |
| `Sm` | `1` | Small (compact). |
| `Md` | `2` | Medium - default control size. |
| `Lg` | `3` | Large. |
| `Xl` | `4` | Extra large. |

## Used by components

- `FlareDataGridPager`
- `FlarePagination`
